title: A node operator could make the Controller fetch an arbitrary URL through the update relay
description:
A node page's `POST /api/lifecycle/upgrade-relay` has the Controller download a release bundle from the `http(s)://` reference the caller gives, then push it to the node (`UploadReleaseFile`) and install it (`Upgrade`), both admin-only on the node. The Controller fetched the reference before the node refused the admin-only calls, and the node page required only the operator role for a POST, so an `os:operator` on a node - including one scoped to a domain other than lifecycle - could point the reference at an internal or metadata address and read the status and connection errors back in the relay's progress stream: a blind request from the Controller's network position (an SSRF oracle). The fetch also followed redirects to any host.

**Affected**: a Controller whose nodes an operator can reach.

**Fix**: the relay refuses, before any fetch, a caller who may not call both `Upgrade` and `UploadReleaseFile` on the node; and it follows a redirect only to the same host.

**Besides updating**: nothing.
